_note: A sum qualifying under Income-tax Act, 2025 s.126(2)(a): "to effect or keep in force an insurance on the health … of the assessee or his family, or any contributions made to the Central Government Health Scheme or such other scheme, as may be notified …, or any payment made for preventive health check-up of the assessee or his family, up to ₹25000 in aggregate" (Gazette 265620, p.161). Entered only as a HealthPayment, never a plain qualifying payment: the limits turn on whom it covers — family ("the spouse and dependant children", s.126(10)(b)) or parents, senior citizen or not (s.126(7), (8)(a)). The insurer's scheme must be approved (s.126(11)) — an entry condition. D-136. TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.80D(2)(a): insurance on the health of the assessee or family, a contribution to the Central Government Health Scheme or a notified scheme, or a preventive check-up (thc p.341). sources/2026-10-07-chapter-via.md B11; D-145.
